name: comment.intents
description: Audience Desk: triage one captured audience comment into a typed intent plus a post-signal heat, so the deterministic idea engine can group by intent without a frontier model in the per-comment loop. Advisory until calibrated.

intent.instructions: Read the comment. What intent does it carry toward whatever it is replying to?

criteria.question: Asks for an answer, a missing fact, or a decision
criteria.pain: Reports frustration, an unmet need, or a problem the writer is living with
criteria.praise: Positive acknowledgement that something worked or landed
criteria.objection: Disagrees, doubts the claim, the price, or the method
criteria.buying_signal: Ready to pay, compare, or take a step (asks how to start, requests a DM, names a budget)
criteria.hype: Excitement with no specifics; buying the energy, not the argument
criteria.other: One-liner, filler, spam, or off-topic with no usable intent

heat.instructions: How strong is this comment as a signal that a post on its topic would land?

is_noise.instructions: The comment is bot-grade filler, spam, an emoji-only reply, or otherwise carries no topical content

rules.reason: filler comment -- carries no post signal, keep it out of the idea corpus (threshold provisional, pending calibration)
hand-raise in the comments -- route to GTM follow-up, not only to a content idea
breakout-level demand -- worth a frontier drafting pass this cycle

notes.intent: created 2026-09-20 for audience-desk; per-comment loop must never call a frontier model (Jev cascade doctrine).
